items.title: A.B. Spellman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 19, 2022
items.q: I thought of this when I started talking about Montmartre. If you look at the early Impressionists, it wasn’t the academic critics who wrote about Manet for example.

ctx.x: And they’d make corrections on them, yes. Yeah I think this thing about, incidentally the thing I want to diverge from your question a bit but it’s related, this thing about artists, about poets learning to write about art forms from the artists themselves. I mean it’s a similar kind of thing that came up and again, going back to, I thought of this when I started talking about Montmartre. If you look at the early Impressionists, it wasn’t the academic critics who wrote about Manet for example. Baudelaire was…
Well you can’t pay for that kind of education.
